page_data.en:
Ching Kyi-sau (秦其孝)
Pootung                                D.S. Pitts
Chengtu Rd.Stn.      31/12/37          D.S.I. Shih Ssu-chien

My name is Ching Kyi-sau, age 29, native of Pootung,
single, residing at the Tai Lee Refugee Camp, North Fukien
Road, where I am acting as a clerk. I receive no wage for
my work, my services being rendered in exchange for free
food and lodging. I was formerly a refugee in the camp
having been sent there about a month ago by the Zung Chi Tang,
35 Yunnan Road, and was later appointed to the job by the sup-
erior officer of the camp. Prior to my taking refuge in
Shanghai I was a school teacher in Chi Ling Primary School,
San Sing Dong, Pootung.

I proceeded to 77 Tsingtao Road to interview
Tsu Zah Doong, a school mate of mine and brother of one Tsu
Zah Foo, who has been working with Mr. Zung in the Education
Department of the S.M.Council in refugee affairs. My object
in the interview was to ask Mr. Tsu to procure me a post as
a teacher in any refugee school so that I might escape the
rigours of the camp.

I have never participated in any anti-Japanese
or political movement and am not a member of any national
salvation association.

The first time I went to Tsingtao Road was about a
month ago and this morning's meeting was the second visit there.
I did not observe any propaganda matter at this address during
my first visit nor anything that might be construed as being
of a political character.

(Signed) Ching Kyi-sau/
page_data.zh:
Ching Kyi-sau (秦其孝)
浦东                                侦探警司 Pitts
成都路站      1937年12月31日          高级侦探督察 Shih Ssu-chien

我叫 Ching Kyi-sau，29岁，浦东人，未婚，居住在北路福民难民收容所（Tai Lee Refugee Camp），
在那里担任职员。我的工作不领取工资，服务以换取免费食宿。
我以前是该收容所的难民，大约一个月前由云南路35号的众济堂（Zung Chi Tang）送往那里，
后来被收容所上级任命为该职位。在来上海避难之前，我是浦东三星荡（San Sing Dong）
启灵小学的教师。

我前往青岛路77号去面试我的同学 Tsu Zah Doong（音译），
他是 Tsu Zah Foo（音译）的兄弟，后者一直与 Zung 先生在
工部局理事会难民事务教育部共事。我面试的目的是请求 Tsu 先生
为我谋取一所难民学校的教师职位，以便我能摆脱收容所的艰苦生活。

我从未参与任何抗日或政治运动，也不是任何救国会的成员。

我第一次去青岛路大约是两个月前，今天早上的会面是第二次去那里。
第一次去时，我没有在该地址观察到任何宣传品，也没有任何可能被解释为
具有政治性质的东西。

（签名）Ching Kyi-sau/

page_data.en:
Kao Kwei-khwung (高閏坤)
Zangseh D.S. Pitts
Chengtu Rd. Stn. 31/12/37 D.S.I. Shih Ssu-chien

My name is Kao Kwei-khwung, age 18, native of Zangseh,
single, unemployed, residing with my parents at 231 Wuting Rd.
I proceeded to 77 Tsingtao Road this morning with
the object of interviewing my former teacher, Fang Ying-min
(方因明), with a request that he endeavour to assist me
in securing work. Between 1931/1934 I was a student at the
San Yoh (三育) Middle School, Changan Road, Chapel, where
Mr. Fang was a teacher. Two or three months ago, I accidentally
met this man on Sinza Road where he told me where he resided.
I visited him shortly after when I learned that he was
connected as a teacher with a certain refugee camp. During
this visit I observed Fang and another man, whose name I do
not know, employing a mimeograph for the reproduction of
certain pamphlets the contents of which I was not aware.
I am not connected in any way with any subversive
organizations and have not taken part in the distribution
of any anti-Japanese propaganda. My father who resides with
me, is a coolie employed by Messrs. Anderson, Meyer & Co.
Ltd. and he can confirm my statement.

(Signed) Kao Kwei-khwung.
page_data.zh:
Kao Kwei-khwung (高閏坤)
常熟 侦探警司 Pitts
成都路站 1937年12月31日 高级侦探督察 Shih Ssu-chien

我叫 Kao Kwei-khwung，18岁，常熟人，未婚，无业，与父母同住于武定路231号。
我今天早上前往青岛路77号，目的是面试我的前老师 Fang Ying-min（方因明），
请求他尽力协助我找工作。1931年至1934年间，我是长安路三育中学的学生，
当时 Fang 先生是该校教师。两三个月前，我在新闸路上偶然遇到这个人，
他告诉了我他的住址。不久后我去拜访了他，得知他与某个难民收容所有教师方面的关联。
在这次拜访中，我观察到 Fang 和另一名我不知其名的男子，正在使用油印机
复制某些小册子，但我并不知晓其内容。
我与任何颠覆性组织没有任何关联，也未参与分发任何抗日宣传品。
与我同住的父亲是和记洋行（Anderson, Meyer & Co. Ltd.）雇用的苦力，
他可以证实我的陈述。

（签名）Kao Kwei-khwung。

page_data.en:
Zung Zao-yoong (陳北雲 )
Anhuei Province D.S. Pitts
Chengtu Rd.Stn. 31/12/37 D.S.I. Shih Ssu-chien

My name is Zung Zao-yoong, age 25, native of Anhuei,
married, residing with my wife at the Yue Zah Tsang Primary
School (余晔小学 ), Gordon Road near Mapai Road of which
I am a principal.

I proceeded to 77 Tsingtao Road with a view to
interviewing one Tse Zah-dong (朱泽东), a fellow countryman
of mine. Tse Zah-dong is the brother of the principal of a
Refugee School which is sponsored by the S.M.C. through
Mr. H.C. Chen, Chinese Educational Officer. My object to see
Mr. Tse was to find out if he knew anything about the school,
because I wish to conduct a refugee school in an endeavour to
apply for a grant-in-aid from the Council.

I have never participated in any anti-Japanese
movement and I am not a member of any national salvation
association.

(Signed) Zung Zao-yoong.
page_data.zh:
Zung Zao-yoong (陳北雲 )
安徽省 侦探警司 Pitts
成都路站 1937年12月31日 高级侦探督察 Shih Ssu-chien

我叫 Zung Zao-yoong，25岁，安徽人，已婚，与妻子同住于戈登路近马白路的余晔小学，
我是该校校长。

我前往青岛路77号是为了面试我的同乡 Tse Zah-dong（朱泽东）。
Tse Zah-dong 是一所难民学校校长的兄弟，该学校由工部局理事会
通过华人教育官 H.C. Chen 先生资助。我见 Tse 先生的目的是想了解
他是否知道这所学校的情况，因为我希望开办一所难民学校，以争取
理事会的补助金。

我从未参与任何抗日运动，也不是任何救国会的成员。

（签名）Zung Zao-yoong。

page_data.en:
Chin Ss-an 許世安，
Huchow                                      D.S. Pitts
Chengtu Rd.Stn.          31/12/37                  D.S.I.Shih Ssu-chien

My name is Chin Ss-an, age 34, native of Huchow,
single, a teacher of the Nanyang Girls' Middle School, Avenue
Road near Tatung Road where I graduated in 1931. I am at
present residing with my parents at No. 15, Lane 63, Wuting
Road.

The object of my proceeding to No. 77 Tsingtao
Road was in response to a letter from one Mr. Tsu Chuan-kyu
(趙傳客), a staff member of the Shanghai International
Red Cross Society, who asked me to interview one Mr. Tsu Tse-foo
(朱澤甫) at the above address in order to introduce me to act
as a teacher in a refugee camp at No. 979 Chengtu Road. I
went to No. 77 Tsingtao Road this morning for this purpose
and unexpectedly I was arrested. (This statement can be
confirmed by the letter found in my handbag).

I am not connected in any way with any anti-
Japanese organs. My aunt Miss Lily Chin (Li Li Chin), who
has just returned from the United States, is well known
locally in Chinese and foreign educational circles and can
vouch for my past behaviour. She resides with my parents
at the above mentioned address and is at present the President
of the Virginia Girls' Middle School, Huchow, which is
temporarily located in the Moore's Memorial Church, Yu Ya
Ching Road.

(Signed) Chin Ss-an.
page_data.zh:
Chin Ss-an 許世安，
湖州                                      侦探警司 Pitts
成都路站          1937年12月31日                  高级侦探督察 Shih Ssu-chien

我叫 Chin Ss-an，34岁，湖州人，未婚，南洋女子中学教师，该校位于大通路附近的爱文义路，
我于1931年毕业于该校。目前我与父母同住于武定路63弄15号。

我前往青岛路77号的目的是回应上海国际红十字会职员 Tsu Chuan-kyu（趙傳客）先生的一封信，
信中要求我在上述地址面试 Tsu Tse-foo（朱澤甫）先生，以便介绍我担任成都路979号
一处难民收容所的教师。我今天早上为此目的前往青岛路77号，却意外被捕。（此陈述可由
在我手提包中发现的信件证实）。

我与任何抗日机关没有任何关联。我的姑姑 Lily Chin 小姐（Li Li Chin），刚从美国回来，
在当地中外教育界颇有名气，可以为我的过往行为作证。她与我的父母同住于上述地址，
现任湖州维真女子中学校长，该校暂借位于虞洽卿路的慕尔纪念堂办学。

（签名）Chin Ss-an。

page_data.en:
Tsai Feh (蔡法)
Pootung                                          D.S. Pitts
Chengtu Rd.Stn.       31/12/37                  D.S.I. Shih Ssu-chien

My name is Tsai Feh, age 25, native of Pootung,
single, unemployed, residing with my brother-in-law at
No. 5 Kan Yue Lee (康餘里), Rue Auguste Hoppe. I was
formerly a teacher of the Kiang Nan Primary School (江南小学)
at No. 8 Feh Keng Lee (費康里), Haining Road, and left
that school early last year having difference in opinion
with the Principal.

I proceeded to 77 Tsingtao Road at 12 noon
December 31 with a view to interviewing a friend of mine
named Ling Yih-sing (林一心) who was residing at this
address with one Mr. Tsu (朱). The object of my visiting
Ling was to seek his advice on my intention to conduct
a primary school, as I understand Mr. Ling had a wide
circle of friends in schools. The first time I met Mr. Ling
was in the Kiang Nan Primary School where he was also
employed as a teacher. About a month ago, I met him outside
the Park Hotel and learned from him where he lived.

I knew nothing about the activities of Ling
or Tsu and have never participated in any political
movement. I am not a member of any national salvation
association.

(Signed) Tsai Feh.
page_data.zh:
Tsai Feh (蔡法)
浦东                                          侦探警司 Pitts
成都路站       1937年12月31日                  高级侦探督察 Shih Ssu-chien

我叫 Tsai Feh，25岁，浦东人，未婚，无业，与姐夫同住于奥古斯特·霍普路（Rue Auguste Hoppe）
康餘里5号。我原是海宁路费康里8号江南小学的教师，去年初因与校长意见不合而离职。

我于12月31日中午12点前往青岛路77号，目的是面试住在那里的我的朋友 Ling Yih-sing（林一心），
他与一位姓 Tsu（朱）的先生同住。我拜访 Ling 的目的是就我打算开办一所小学的意向征求他的建议，
因为我了解到 Ling 先生在学校方面交友广泛。我第一次见到 Ling 先生是在江南小学，当时他也受雇为教师。
大约一个月前，我在国际饭店外遇到他，并从他那里得知了他的住址。

我对 Ling 或 Tsu 的活动一无所知，也从未参与任何政治运动。我不是任何救国会的成员。

（签名）Tsai Feh。

page_data.en:
Lee Ying (李英)
Hunan Province                                     D.S. Pitts
Chengtu Rd.Stn.       31/12/37                     D.S.I. Shih Sew-chien

My name is Lee Ying, age 23, native of Hunan,
single, female, residing on the premises of the International
First Refugee Relief Camp, Rue Massenet, where I have been
acting as a teacher since its opening shortly after the
outbreak of the local hostilities. A Catholic Mother, who
is an acquaintance of my uncle, introduced me to this job.
        I graduated from the Tsen Nan Girl Middle
School, Changsha, Hunan, about two years ago and shortly
afterwards I came to Shanghai with the object of continuing
my studies. I did not go to any school in Shanghai but was
introduced by my uncle to become a teacher in the Yue Zah
Chang 2nd Primary School (余章小学), Yangtsepoo Road,
which job I held until the outbreak of the local hostilities.
        About two weeks ago, one Miss Yang Pao (杨宝.)
came to the Refugee Camp where I am working and told me that
one Mr. Ling Yih-sing (林一心), residing at No. 77 Tsingtao
Road, was about to open schools for refugees, and as she
understood that Mr. Tsu (朱) was in need of school teachers
for the refugee schools, Miss Yang advised me to apply to
Mr. Tsu for the job.
        I went to 77 Tsingtao Road at about 12 noon,
Dec. 31, for the purpose as abovementioned and on entering
the premises I was arrested.
        I have never participated in any political
movement and I am not a member of any national salvation
association.
                                (Signed) Lee Ying.
page_data.zh:
李英 (Lee Ying)
湖南省                                     D.S. Pitts
成都路捕房       1937年12月31日                     副督察长 施世坚 (Shih Sew-chien)

本人李英，23岁，湖南籍，
未婚，女性，现居住于马思南路 (Rue Massenet) 国际
第一难民收容所内，自当地战事爆发后不久该所开设以来，
我一直在此担任教师。一位天主教修女，也是我叔父的
熟人，介绍我得到这份工作。
        我大约两年前毕业于湖南长沙的
震南女子中学，随后不久便来到上海，目的是继续
求学。我在上海并未进入任何学校就读，而是由叔父
介绍，在杨树浦路余章小学 (Yue Zah Chang 2nd Primary School)
担任教师，直至当地战事爆发。
        约两周前，一位杨宝小姐 (Miss Yang Pao)
来到我工作的难民收容所，告诉我住在青岛路77号的
林一心先生 (Mr. Ling Yih-sing) 正准备为难民开办学校，
据她了解，朱先生 (Mr. Tsu) 急需为难民学校招聘教师，
因此杨小姐建议我向朱先生申请该职位。
        12月31日中午12时许，我出于上述目的
前往青岛路77号，进入该处后即被逮捕。
        我从未参与任何政治
运动，也不是任何救国会的成员。
                                (签名) 李英。

page_data.en:
Tseu Wen-fu (周文虎)
Woosung                                      D.S. Pitts
Chengtu Rd.Stn.        31/12/37              Clerk Liao Chung-chien

My name is Tseu Wen-fu, age 29, single, native of
Woosung, residing in the 3rd Refugee Camp of the International
Relief Committee at Rue Luscn, with which I am employed as a
teacher of the refugees.
When the Sino-Japanese hostilities broke out in
August 1937, I came to take refuge in Shanghai from Woosung.
At the beginning of September, 1937, I joined the above
mentioned refugee camp through the recommendation of my friend,
Mr. Tseu Ching-sung (周慶生) who was an officer in the camp.
My grand mother, mother and sister are residing in the Kwa
Fan Refugee Camp, Avenue Road.
On December 29, I met my friend Tseu Tso-zang
(周左常), a teacher of the Chueh De (覺德) Primary School,
Gorden Road near Robison Road, who told me that one Mr. Ling
Yih-sing (林一心), residing at 77 Tsingtao Road, was arrang-
ing to organise a primary school and intended to engage a
number of teachers. He also advised me to approach Ling for
employment.
At 12.30 p.m. Dec. 31, I called at No. 77 Tsingtao
Road, when I was arrested by the police and taken to the
Police Station.
I had never participated in any political parties
and I do not know any of the members of the national salvation
associations.

(Signed) Tseu Wen-Fu.
page_data.zh:
周文虎 (Tseu Wen-fu)
吴淞                                      D.S. Pitts
成都路捕房        1937年12月31日              文书 廖仲坚 (Liao Chung-chien)

本人周文虎，29岁，未婚，吴淞籍，
现居住在吕班路 (Rue Luscn) 国际救济委员会第三难民收容所，
受雇为难民教师。
1937年8月中日战事爆发时，我从吴淞来沪避难。
1937年9月初，经我的朋友、当时在该收容所任职的
周庆生先生 (Mr. Tseu Ching-sung) 推荐，我加入了上述
难民收容所。我的祖母、母亲和妹妹现居住在爱文义路 (Avenue Road)
瓜范难民收容所。
12月29日，我遇见了我的朋友周左常
(Tseu Tso-zang)，他是罗宾森路 (Robison Road) 附近戈登路 (Gorden Road)
觉德 (Chueh De) 小学的教师，他告诉我，住在青岛路77号的
林一心先生 (Mr. Ling Yih-sing) 正筹备组织一所小学，并打算聘请
多名教师。他还建议我去找林先生求职。
12月31日下午12时30分，我前往青岛路77号，
随即被警察逮捕并带往捕房。
我从未参加过任何政党，也不认识任何救国会
的成员。

(签名) 周文虎。

page_data.en:
Weng Lee-sung (王連生)
Haimen                                D.S. Pitts
Changtu Rd.Stn.      31/12/37              Clerk Liao Chung-chi

My name is Weng Lee-sung, age 25, native of Haimen,
single, residing with my parents at No. 155 Kuling Road. I
am at present unemployed. Formerly I was employed with Lester
Chinese Hospital, Shantung Road, as a telephone operator, but
left the employment in November 1936 owing to some quarrel
with my office mates.

On December 23, 1937, I visited my friend Mr. Zung
Tsing (程俊), a clerk in the Chinese Maritime Customs
Employees Club, Dong Yih Lee, Bubbling Well Road, at his
office and requested him to introduce a free medical adviser
to my friend, Mr. Ma (馬), a conductor of the China Omnibus
Company, one of whose relatives is going to give birth. On
December 27, my friend Zung came to my house, I myself being
absent at the time, and handed a letter of recommendation for
the medical adviser as well as four rolls of a periodical
entitled "The Garden of Employees" to my mother with the
request that I deliver them to the addresses mentioned thereon
on his behalf.

In the afternoon of Dec. 31, I delivered the
four rolls of periodical to the following places:
(1) Mr. Tsang Kang-chih (章康枝), Commercial
Press, Henan Road.
(2) Mr. Wang (王), Tang Hing Company (誠信洋行),
Kiukiang Road (number forgotten).
(3) Mr. Tan (譚), Shanghai Telephone Co.,
Kiangsu Road.
page_data.zh:
王连生 (Weng Lee-sung)
海门                                D.S. Pitts
成都路捕房      1937年12月31日              文书 廖仲基 (Liao Chung-chi)

本人王连生，25岁，海门籍，
未婚，与父母同住于古岭路 (Kuling Road) 155号。我
目前失业。此前我曾受雇于山东路莱斯特华人医院
(Lester Chinese Hospital) 担任电话接线员，但因与同事
发生争执，于1936年11月离职。

1937年12月23日，我去拜访我的朋友程俊
(Mr. Zung Tsing) 先生，他是中国海关职员俱乐部 (Chinese Maritime Customs
Employees Club) 的职员，办公地点位于静安寺路 (Bubbling Well Road)
东伊利大楼 (Dong Yih Lee)。我请求他为我的一位朋友马先生
(Mr. Ma) 介绍一位免费医疗顾问，马先生是中国公共汽车公司
(China Omnibus Company) 的售票员，其亲属即将分娩。12月27日，
我的朋友程俊来到我家，当时我不在家，他将一封医疗顾问的
推荐信以及四卷名为《职苑》("The Garden of Employees") 的期刊
交给我母亲，并请我代他将这些物品送至信上注明的地址。

12月31日下午，我将这四卷期刊送至以下地点：
(1) 章康枝先生 (Mr. Tsang Kang-chih)，河南路商务印书馆。
(2) 王先生 (Mr. Wang)，九江路诚信洋行 (Tang Hing Company)（门牌号遗忘）。
(3) 谭先生 (Mr. Tan)，江苏路上海电话公司。

page_data.en:
- 2 -
(4) Mr. Ling (林 ), No. 77 Tsingtao Rd.
At about 8 p.m. December 31, when I arrived at
No. 77 Tsingtao Road with a view to delivering the
periodical to the address, I was arrested by detectives of
the S.M.P. and was taken to the Chengtu Road Station.
I have never participated in any political
organizations nor have I undertaken any national salvation
activities. I only know that my friend Zung is a clerk
of the Customs Employees Club but I do not know whether
he is a member of the national salvation association.

(Signed) Wong Lee-sung.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -
(4) 林先生 (Mr. Ling )，青岛路77号。
12月31日晚8时许，当我抵达
青岛路77号准备投递期刊时，被工部局警务处
侦探逮捕，并被带往成都路捕房。
我从未参与任何政治
组织，也未从事任何救国活动。我只知道我的朋友程俊是
海关职员俱乐部的职员，但我不知道他是否是救国会的成员。

(签名) 王连生 (Wong Lee-sung)。

page_data.en:
Ho Ping (何平) alias Ho Ying (何英).
Hankow                                      D.S. McKeown
Chengtu Rd Stn.  3.15a.m. 31.12.37.         D.S.I. Mao Yen-ken.

My name is Ho Ping alias Ho Ying, aged 26, a native
of Hankow and married.    I am a school teacher by profession,
being a teacher in the Yangtsepoo Social Centre Primary
School, Yangtsepoo Road, prior to the hostilities.    I
am living in 77 Tsingtao Road.

I am now serving in the Women's Class of the 7th
Ningpo Fellow Countrymen's Association, Myburgh Road, near
Avenue Road.    This class is opened by an "Education
Developing Service Group" (普及教育服務團), which was formed
following the outbreak of hostilities and aimed at national
salvation work.    The Group, with an office at 77 Tsingtao
Road, was declared dissolved when the Chinese troops withdrew
from the Shanghai Area.    It, however, continues to function
secretly at the same address.    At first I was paid $10
per month without lodging, but at present I am paid $6
with free lodging at 77 Tsingtao Road.    I am paid by Ling
Ih-sing (林心), one of the leading members of the Group.
There are about 40 workers operating in about 20 classes
known as "Children's classes" or "Women's classes."

Tsu Shih-tung (朱澤東), a male youth of about 20,
is the man watching the place and receiving letters and
messages.

Ling Ih-sing visits the place, 77 Tsingtao Road, from
time to time.    His whereabouts is not known.

In the women's class I am teaching, I was instructed
to teach things in connection with the national salvation
before the withdrawal of the Chinese troops, but after the
page_data.zh:
何平 (Ho Ping)，又名何英 (Ho Ying)。
汉口                                      D.S. McKeown
成都路捕房  1937年12月31日凌晨3时15分         副督察长 毛彦根 (Mao Yen-ken)。

本人何平，又名何英，26岁，汉口籍，已婚。    我的职业是教师，
战事前曾在杨树浦路杨树浦社会中心小学任教。    我
现居住在青岛路77号。

我目前在迈尔西爱路 (Myburgh Road) 近爱文义路处的
宁波同乡会第七分会妇女班服务。    该班级由一个“普及教育服务团”
(Education Developing Service Group) 开办，该团体是在战事爆发后
成立的，旨在进行救国工作。    该团体办事处设在青岛路77号，
在中国军队撤离上海地区时被宣布解散。    然而，它仍在同一地址
秘密运作。    起初我月薪10元，不包食宿，但目前月薪6元，
并在青岛路77号免费住宿。    我的薪水由该团体的主要领导成员之一
林一心 (Ling Ih-sing) 支付。    大约有40名工作人员在约20个被称为
“儿童班”或“妇女班”的班级中工作。

周泽东 (Tsu Shih-tung)，一名约20岁的男青年，
负责看守该处并接收信件和消息。

林一心 (Ling Ih-sing) 不时访问青岛路77号该处。    他的行踪不明。

在我任教的妇女班中，在中国军队撤离之前，我被指示
教授与救国相关的内容，但在

page_data.en:
- 2 -

withdrawal in view of the local tense situation, I
abandoned all political activities and devoted myself
to pure education.

There was a mimeograph machine on the premises.
I remember that some class teachers made use of it to
print coloured New Year greeting cards, the contents of
which I have not seen nor do I know.

In celebration of the New Year, I only asked
the students, numbering 30, to contribute towards the
relief of refugees and would like to instruct some students
to dance in refugee camps as entertainment on January 1.
I do not use greeting cards.

I am not a Communist.

(Signed) Ho Ping alias Ho Ying.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

撤离后，鉴于当地局势紧张，我
放弃了所有政治活动，致力于纯粹的教育工作。

该处有一台油印机。
我记得有些班级教师利用它印制彩色新年贺卡，
其内容我未曾见过，也不知晓。

为庆祝新年，我只要求30名学生捐款用于
难民救济，并打算指导一些学生在1月1日到难民收容所
表演舞蹈作为娱乐。    我不使用贺卡。

我不是共产党员。

(签名) 何平，又名何英。

30/12/37.

Arrest of members of the "Foreign Owned Firms
Chinese Employees Lien Hui Society and Vocational
Circles National Salvation Association".

At 3 p.m. on 30/12/37, a party of Police consisting
of D.I. Hill, D.S. McKeown, D.S.I. Kao Yien Kien (both
of Special Branch), C.D.C. 150 and the undersigned, act-
ing on instructions of Major Bourne D.C. (Special Branch)
raided Room 218, Bubbling Well Building, 749 B'Well
Road and therein arrested 3 male Chinese:-

(1) Wong Ning Yang (王明揚), 24, Ningpo,
M/salesman, 20 Jai Foh Li, Mandalay Road.
(2) Yang Yuen Kong (楊元康), 24, Ningpo,
M/shroff, 490 Avenue Foch.
(3) Tseu Zung Tuh (周成佐), 18, Ningpo,
/Unemployed clerk, Room 218, 749 B'Well Road.

and seized a large quantity of Chinese paper flags, New
Year Greeting Cards, and other literature, all Anti-
Japanese in character and documents relating to the
National Salvation Movement.

The seized property was taken to Headquarters for
examination, the 3 arrested men being brought to
Chengtu Road Station for interrogation.

D.I. Hill, D.S. Dickson, D.S. Reesly and C.D.C. 150.

成都路
1937年12月30日。

(1) 王明扬 (Wong Ning Yang)，24岁，宁波人，男/推销员，曼达雷路 (Mandalay Road) 嘉福里20号。
(2) 杨元康 (Yang Yuen Meng)，24岁，宁波人，男/出纳员，福煦路490号。

静安寺路749号静安大楼218室，
1937年12月30日。

逮捕“外商华员联合会及职业界救国会”成员。

1937年12月30日下午3时，一支由督察希尔 (Hill)、侦探麦基翁 (McKeown)、副督察高彦坚 (Kao Yien Kien)（均属特务科）、刑事侦缉队长150号及本人组成的警察队伍，奉特务科副总监伯恩 (Bourne) 少校之命，突袭了静安寺路749号静安大楼218室，并在室内逮捕了三名中国男子：-

(1) 王明扬 (Wong Ning Yang)，24岁，宁波人，
男/推销员，曼达雷路嘉福里20号。
(2) 杨元康 (Yang Yuen Kong)，24岁，宁波人，
男/出纳员，福煦路490号。
(3) 周成佐 (Tseu Zung Tuh)，18岁，宁波人，
/失业职员，静安寺路749号218室。

并缴获大量中文纸旗、新年贺卡及其他文献，均具有反日性质，以及涉及救国运动的文件。

缴获的物品被送往总部进行检查，三名被捕男子被带至成都路捕房接受审讯。

督察希尔，侦探迪克森 (Dickson)，侦探里斯利 (Reesly) 及刑事侦缉队长150号。

根据督察希尔的指令，成都路捕房的侦探在突袭房间内部署了不定期的监视，结果在1937年12月30日下午6时至午夜12时之间又实施了7次逮捕，具体如下：-
(4) 徐振裕 (Zee Tsang Yue) 失业。
(5) 王乙 (Wong Yih)，又名王街远 (Wong Ai Yue)。
失业。
(6) 罗哲原 (Loo Chi Yuan) 学徒。
(7) 凌联芳 (Ling Lien Fong) 面粉店合伙人。
(8) 李业勤 (Li Nyih Jing) 失业。
(9) 胡牌文 (Oo Ching Wen) 失业。
(10) 卢文赖 (Loo Wen Lai) 失业。
从最后提到的人那里获得情报，称大量反日文献储存在住在青岛路77号的林一心 (Ling Yih Sing) 家中。警察队伍于晚上11时至午夜12时之间前往该处，发现了大量反日文献和一台油印机，并予以缴获。
在据称由林一心租用的楼上房间里，发现了两名女性，名叫金静 (King-jing) 和何平 (Ho Ping)。
由于她们出现在发现反日文献的房间内，这两名女性被带往捕房。

page_data.en:
Wong Ming Yang (王明揚)
Ningpo                                      D.S. McKeown
Chengtu Rd. Stn.       30/12/37             D.S.I. Kao Yen Ken

My name is Wong Ming Yang, aged 24, a native of Ningpo,
and married. I am a salesman of the China National Insurance
Company, China Land Bank Building, corner of Peking and Kiang-
se Roads, and reside at 20 Kiu Foh Li, Mandalay Road. I am
a member of the Foreign Owned Firms Chinese Employees Lien
Nyi Society, formerly situated at 115 Hankow Road and now at
Footung Bank Building (2nd floor), corner of Avenue Rd. VII
and Honan Road, which was part of the Vocational Circles
National Salvation Association. Automatically I became
member of the national salvation association, which was dis-
solved following the withdrawal of the Chinese forces.
At the end of November 1937, Yang Yien Siu (楊延修),
compradore of the Assurance Franco-Asiatique, Rue Montauban,
and concurrently a staff member of the Organisation Section
of the Foreign Owned Firm Chinese Employees' Lien Nyi Society,
asked me to assist him in conducting national salvation works.
among refugees. He belongs to the Vocational Circles National
Salvation Association, with secret offices the addresses of
which I do not know. Although I am a member of this organiza-
tion, I merely receive orders from Yang. The work among the
the refugees is a part of the programme of the Vocational
Circles National Salvation Association. My principal work is
to deliver articles, including flags and cards. Although a
number of persons work in this organization, I only know the
following persons:-
1. Yang Yien Siu
2. Yang Yuan Kong (in custody).
page_data.zh:
王明扬 (Wong Ming Yang)
宁波                                      D.S. McKeown
成都路捕房       1937年12月30日             副督察长 高彦肯 (Kao Yen Ken)

本人王明扬，24岁，宁波籍，
已婚。我是中国保险公司的推销员，该公司位于北京路与江西路转角的中国垦业银行大楼，现居住在曼达雷路久福里20号。我是外商华员联合会 (Foreign Owned Firms Chinese Employees Lien Nyi Society) 的成员，该会原址位于汉口路115号，现址位于爱文义路七段与河南路转角的福通银行大楼（二楼），该会是职业界救国会的一部分。我自动成为救国会会员，该会在中方军队撤离后解散。
1937年11月底，蒙脱班路 (Rue Montauban) 法亚保险公司 (Assurance Franco-Asiatique) 的买办、同时兼任外商华员联合会组织科职员的杨延修 (Yang Yien Siu) 先生，请我协助他在难民中开展救国工作。他属于职业界救国会，其秘密办事处的地址我并不知晓。虽然我是该组织的成员，但我仅接受杨的命令。在难民中的工作是职业界救国会计划的一部分。我的主要工作是递送物品，包括旗帜和卡片。虽然有许多人在该组织中工作，但我只认识以下人员：-
1. 杨延修
2. 杨元康（在押）。

page_data.en:
- 2 -
3. Wong Moo Vung (王慕文), unemployed, living in Room 218,
Bubbling Well Building, Bubbling Well Road, who deals
with the printing of the cards & and other matters.
4. Chun Hung (春虹), a school teacher by profession, where-
abouts unknown.
I understand that all the other work is detailed to persons
by Yang Yien Siu. Room 218 was formerly occupied by the
Native Bank Employees Lien Nyi Society and vacated about three
days ago. From the commencement of December up to now, I and
the other members used the room as a communication address.
Through the arrangements made by Wong Moo Vung, a quantity of
flags, cards, printed matter as well as a mimeograph were
brought to the room about two or three days ago.
With regard to the "Refugee Camp Workers Lien Nyi Society",
I understand that before the withdrawal of Chinese troops
from Shanghai, the Vocational Circles National Salvation Asso-
ciation convened meetings of a number of workers of refugees
camps from time to time, and thus they formed an organization
known as the "Refugee Camp Workers Lien Nyi Society". I
also know that Chun Hung is the member of the Vocational
Circles National Salvation Association who communicates with
the Refugee Camp Workers Lien Nyi Society.
At about 2.30 p.m. December 30, I arrived at the room
in the Bubbling Building, Bubbling Well Road, with a view
to discussing with Wong Moo Vung the distribution of the flags
cards and a periodical entitled "Friends of Refugees" to
various refugee camps before the New Year. While I was waiting
page_data.zh:
- 2 -
3. 王慕文（Wong Moo Vung），无业，居住于静安寺路静安大楼218室，负责印刷卡片及其他事务。
4. 春虹（Chun Hung），职业为教师，下落不明。
据我所知，所有其他工作均由杨延修（Yang Yien Siu）分派给相关人员。218室此前由华商银行职员联益社占用，约三天前搬空。自十二月初至今，我与其他成员将该房间用作通讯联络地址。通过王慕文的安排，大约两三天前，一批旗帜、卡片、印刷品以及一台油印机被带入该房间。
关于“难民收容所工作人员联益社”，据我了解，在中国军队撤离上海之前，职业界救国会不时召集各难民收容所的工作人员开会，从而组建了一个名为“难民收容所工作人员联益社”的组织。我也知道春虹是职业界救国会的成员，负责与难民收容所工作人员联益社进行联络。
12月30日下午2时30分左右，我抵达静安寺路静安大楼的房间，旨在与王慕文讨论在新年前向各难民收容所分发旗帜、卡片及一份名为《难友》的期刊事宜。当我正在等待

page_data.en:
- 3 -
for him, the Police came and took me to Chengtu Road Station.
All the addresses of various refugee camps as well as the flags,
cards, and the periodical are in the charge of Wong Moo Vung.
It was intended that a parcel be delivered to Jen Chi Tang
Benevolent Society, 35 Yunnan Road, for distribution among its
refugee camps and distribution to other camps be dealt with by
me and my assistant Yang Yuan Kong (in custody).
I do not know the present secret organization of the
Vocational Circles National Salvation Association. I only
know Yang Yien Siu under whom I work in the Association.
As to Yang Yuan Kong, I met him at the corner of Bubbling
Well and Yates Roads at about 10 a.m. December 30 and as he
is my friend and also a member of the Vocational Circles
National Salvation Association, I asked him to attend Room 218
Bubbling Building, Bubbling Well Road and help to deliver
parcels.
page_data.zh:
- 3 -
他时，警察到来并将我带至成都路捕房。各难民收容所的所有地址以及旗帜、卡片和期刊均由王慕文保管。原计划将一个包裹送至云南路35号仁济堂善会，由其在其管理的难民收容所中进行分发，而向其他收容所的分发工作则由我和我的助手杨元康（在押）负责处理。
我不了解职业界救国会目前的秘密组织架构。我只知道我在该会中受杨延修领导。
至于杨元康，我于12月30日上午10时左右在静安寺路与亚尔培路（Yates Road）转角处遇见他。鉴于他是我的朋友，也是职业界救国会的成员，我便请他前往静安寺路静安大楼218室，协助运送包裹。

page_data.en:
Yang Yuan Keng (楊元康)
Ningpo                                      D.S. McKeown
Chengtu Rd. Stn      30/12/37               D.S.I. Kao Yen Ken

My name is Yang Yuan Keng, aged 24, native of Ningpo,
and a shroff in the employ of the Foch Rubber Co., 490 Av.
Foch. I reside on the premises of the firm.
    At about 10 a.m. December 30, at the corner of Bubbling
Well and Yates Roads, I met Wong Ming Yang (王明揚), now in
custody, a salesman in the employ of the China Insurance Co.,
Avenue Joffre (formerly situated on Szechuen Road), who was
a fellow member of the Vocational Circles National Salvation
Association prior to the withdrawal of Chinese troops from
Shanghai. He told me that as the situation was very tense,
workers for the national salvation movement were few and that
it was proposed that national flags should be hoisted in
refugee camps in celebration of the New Year Festival. He did
not tell me who proposed the movement. He requested me to
call at his "place", Room 218 Bubbling Well Building, Bubbling
Well Road, off Carter Road, at 2 p.m. and take a bundle of
national flags to the Jen Chi Tang Benevolent Society, 35
Yunnan Road, which takes charge of a part of local refugee
camps. At 2.30 p.m. I arrived at the room where I met Wong
and was given a bundle of flags with instructions to take it
to the Refugee Reception Section of the Jen Chi Tang (i.e.
the Disaster Relief Federation of Shanghai Benevolent Societies)
    I have not engaged in any "national salvation" activities
since the withdrawal of the Chinese troops, when all local
national salvation associations were dissolved. I learned
recently from my friends that these associations had lately
endeavoured to resume operations secretly and were maintaining
page_data.zh:
楊元康
宁波                                      D.S. McKeown
成都路捕房      1937年12月30日               高级巡长 高恩坚（Kao Yen Ken，音译）

我叫杨元康，24岁，宁波人，受雇于福煦路490号福昌橡胶公司（Foch Rubber Co.）担任出纳员。我居住在公司宿舍内。
    12月30日上午10时左右，在静安寺路与亚尔培路（Yates Road）转角处，我遇见了王明扬（Wong Ming Yang，现被拘留），他是霞飞路（原位于四川路）中国保险公司的推销员，在中国军队撤离上海之前，我们曾是职业界救国会的同事。他告诉我，由于局势非常紧张，从事救国运动的工作人员很少，有人提议在难民收容所悬挂国旗以庆祝新年。他并未告知我是谁提出了这一倡议。他要求我于下午2时前往他的“地点”，即卡特路（Carter Road）旁静安寺路静安大楼218室，取一包国旗送往云南路35号仁济堂善会，该机构负责管理部分本地难民收容所。下午2时30分，我到达该房间，见到了王某，并收到一包旗帜，奉命将其送往仁济堂（即上海慈善团体联合救灾会）的难民接待部。
    自中国军队撤离、本地各救国会解散以来，我未参与任何“救国”活动。我最近从朋友处得知，这些协会近期试图秘密恢复运作，并维持着

page_data.en:
- 2 -
offices in private houses. Meanwhile these organizations are
in close touch with each other. The workers of these Bodies
are few. The room in the Bubbling Building is temporarily
occupied for national salvation activities in refugee camps.
It is the first time that I visited the room on the afternoon
of December 30. I do not know the names of the promoters of
the national salvation movement and I can give no information
concerning their meeting places.

(Signed) Yang Yuan Kong.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -
在私人住宅中的办事处。同时，这些组织之间保持着密切联系。这些机构的工作人员很少。静安大楼的房间是临时用于难民收容所救国活动的场所。这是我第一次于12月30日下午访问该房间。我不知道救国运动发起人的姓名，也无法提供有关其集会地点的信息。

（签名）杨元康。

page_data.en:
Tseu Zung Teh (周成德)
Ningpo                                      D.S. McKeown
Chengtu Rd Stn.        30/12/37             Clerk Loh Wei Kong

My name is Tseu Zung Teh, age 18, native of
Ningpo, single and unemployed.
    Following the outbreak of the local Sino-Japanese
hostilities, I left for Ningpo and remained at my native
place until December 4 when I returned here by steamer,
with a view to seeking employment. After returning, I
stayed in the premises of the Kuh Sung Company, a cotton
exchange agency, No.1 Szechuen Road, now closed, where I
was formerly employed as a telephone operator. (It was a
Chinese concern, but the manager was Japanese). Four days
later I left this place and went to reside with my friend
Woo Dah-ming (邱達明), room 15, 110 Avenue Edward VII.
Woo formerly was also employed by the Kuh Sung Company
as an accountant.
    During the afternoon of December 12, at about
2 p.m., I went to see Zee Tseng-yue (徐振裕), a friend
of mine, and an apprentice of the Van Foong (萬丰)
Cereal Hong, No.1 Szechuen Road, at his place of employment,
and requested him to seek employment for me. He promised
to consider my request. On the forenoon of December 13,
Zee Tseng-yue came to see me at Room 15, 110 Avenue Edward
VII, and told me to see one named Zung (程 ), at 10 Doong
Yih Li, Bubbling Well Road. I accordingly went there on
the afternoon of the same day, when Zung asked me to take
care of old cotton clothes contributed by the public for
the relief of refugees, and promised me a monthly subsidy
of $6.00. I went to Room 218, Bubbling Well Apartments
page_data.zh:
周成德（Tseu Zung Teh）
宁波                                      D.S. McKeown
成都路捕房        1937年12月30日             书记员 罗伟江（Loh Wei Kong，音译）

我叫周成德，18岁，宁波人，未婚，无业。
    本地中日战事爆发后，我前往宁波，并在家乡停留至12月4日，随后乘轮船返回此地，以求谋职。回来后，我借住在四川路1号库松公司（Kuh Sung Company，一家棉花交易所代理机构，现已关闭）的 premises 内，我曾受雇于该公司担任电话接线员。（这是一家华商企业，但经理是日本人）。四天后，我离开该处，前往我的朋友邱达明（Woo Dah-ming）处居住，地址为爱德华七世路110号15室。邱以前也受雇于库松公司担任会计。
    12月12日下午2时左右，我去看望我的朋友徐振裕（Zee Tseng-yue），他是四川路1号万丰粮行的一名学徒，并在其工作地点请求他为我谋求职位。他答应考虑我的请求。12月13日上午，徐振裕来到爱德华七世路110号15室看我，并让我去见一位姓程（Zung）的人，地址在静安寺路东义里10号。我遂于当日下午前往，程某让我负责照料公众捐赠用于救济难民的旧棉衣，并承诺每月给我6.00元的津贴。我去了静安公寓

page_data.en:
- 2 -

On December 15, by order of Zung, where I met Wong Mou-wen
(王慕文), who claimed to be a member of the Refugee
Camp Workers' Lien Nyi Society. Zung told me to receive
some 80 old cotton padded vests sent by a certain person,
and instructed me to distribute them to all persons who
visited the room and applied for them. Some 70 of these
vests were distributed, while the remainder are still being
kept in the room.

Before December 15, I was living with Woo Dah-ming
in Room 15, 110 Avenue Edward VII, and Zee Tseng-yue, who
had resigned from the Van Foong Cereal Hong, also came to
stay with us on December 14. Due to the fact that Woo
Dah-ming objected to us living in his room, Zee Tseng-yue
and I removed to the room above the Keng Sing Li (耕莘里),
Weihaiwei Road, where we stayed until December 27, when I
removed to Room 218, Bubbling Well Apartments, Bubbling Well
Road, on the morning, and Zee Tseng-yue also removed to
this address during the afternoon of the same day. Zee,
however, came to occupy the room on December 28.

On December 28, Wong Mou-wen showed me some 3,000
copies of the Chinese National Flag printed on paper, and
300 new year greeting cards kept in the room, and told me
to distribute them to all persons who called at the room
and applied for them. On the forenoon of December 29,
three Chinese (all about thirty years of age), claiming
to be members of refugee camps, came to the room, and each
produced a chit and asked for the issue of the flags and
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

12月15日，按程某的命令，我在那里见到了王慕文（Wong Mou-wen），他自称是难民收容所工作人员联益社的成员。程某让我接收某人送来的约80件旧棉背心，并指示我将它们分发给所有来到房间申请领取的人。其中约70件背心已分发，其余仍存放在房间内。

12月15日之前，我与邱达明同住于爱德华七世路110号15室，而从万丰粮行辞职的徐振裕也于12月14日来与我们同住。由于邱达明反对我们住在他的房间里，徐振裕和我搬到了威海卫路耕莘里楼上的房间，我们一直住到12月27日。当天上午，我搬到了静安寺路静安公寓218室，徐振裕也在当天下午搬到了该地址。不过，徐是在12月28日才正式入住该房间的。

12月28日，王慕文向我展示了存放在房间内的约3,000份纸质印刷的中国国旗和300张新年贺卡，并让我将它们分发给所有来到房间申请领取的人。12月29日上午，三名中国人（年龄均在三十岁左右）来到房间，自称是难民收容所成员，每人出示了一张纸条，要求领取旗帜和

page_data.en:
- 3 -
new year greeting cards. I accordingly distributed to
each of them some 100 copies of the paper flag. Since
then no one has visited the room.
I have no knowledge regarding the organization of
the Refugee Camp Workers' Lien Nyi Society.

Signed : Tseu Zung Teh.
page_data.zh:
- 3 -
新年贺卡。于是我向每人分发了约100份纸质旗帜。此后无人再来过该房间。
我对难民收容所工作人员联益社的组织情况一无所知。

签名：周成德。
